title: CREATE more
description: Create but there's MORE mods and additions.
body:
A modern Create-centered modpack built for smooth performance, immersive automation, and clean survival gameplay.
Design powerful factories with Create, Create Additions, Create Deco, Create: Steam ’n Rails, and fluid-powered machinery. Watch your world come alive with moving contraptions, rotating gears, trains, and kinetic systems — all without relying on magic or excessive tech trees.
This pack focuses on:
 Mechanical automation over redstone clutter


 Railways, factories, and large-scale builds


 High performance with Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, FerriteCore, and modern rendering mods


 Quality-of-life improvements like Jade, Xaero’s Minimap, Better Ping Display, and visual enhancements


 Immersion & aesthetics with dynamic FPS, sounds, animations, and UI polish


Whether you’re building elegant contraptions or massive industrial complexes, this modpack rewards creativity, engineering, and efficiency — all while staying smooth and stable.
No magic. No nonsense. Just motion.
